name: AssistVR
summary: Speech-and-pointing selection: the user points a ray and describes the target's properties by voice to single it out.
howItWorks: The user points at the region of the target and characterises it in speech (for example by colour, shape or name); the system filters the candidates by that description and selects the matching object.
